arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back, ~57 min. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (pod CP 147 W, est. sustainable ~150 W), spend pod reserve evenly, finish sprint from ~600 m left. Steps: (1) let start settle by min 3; (2) min 5-15 judge CP from heart-rate trend at steady effort (rising HR at steady power = above CP); consider a short test piece to check CP/efficiency if unclear; (3) watch for drag incidents (push_local falls at same pod power in both directions = weed/drag), pod drift (pod vs boat power ratio shifts), radio course changes; (4) final 600 m: finish cue.
